description: This file defines classes related to managing input nodes for kernel operations within PyTorch's _inductor backend. It provides abstract and specialized classes for handling input data structures, tensor shapes, device info, and layout configurations for matrix multiplication kernels.

classes.name: KernelInputs
classes.description: Abstract base class for managing kernel input nodes, providing common methods for shape, dtype, device, and layout information.

classes.name: MMKernelInputs
classes.description: Specialized subclass for matrix multiplication kernels, adding methods to handle M, N, K dimensions and output layout specifics.

methods.name: list[Any] nodes(self, reorder: Optional[Sequence[int]] = None)
methods.description: Returns the list of input nodes, optionally reordered based on provided indices.

methods.name: int count(self)
methods.description: Returns the number of input nodes.

methods.name: Optional[str] device_type(self)
methods.description: Returns the device type (like 'cuda' or 'cpu') of the first input node.

methods.name: torch.device device(self)
methods.description: Returns the device object of the first input node.

methods.name: Optional[str] device_name(self)
methods.description: Returns the device name information, especially for CUDA devices.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[Any,...],...] shapes_symbolic(self)
methods.description: Returns symbolic shapes for all input nodes.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[int,...],...] shapes_hinted(self)
methods.description: Returns shape hints as integers for all input nodes.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[sympy.Integer,...],...] strides_symbolic(self)
methods.description: Returns symbolic strides for all input nodes.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[int,...],...] strides_hinted(self)
methods.description: Returns stride hints as integers for all input nodes.

methods.name: tuple[torch.dtype,...] dtypes(self)
methods.description: Returns data types for all input nodes.

methods.name: torch.dtype dtype(self, idx: int = 0)
methods.description: Returns data type of the node at specified index.

methods.name: torch.dtype out_dtype(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to return output data type.

methods.name: Union[float,int] get_scalar(self, name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a scalar value by name from stored scalars.

methods.name: Layout output_layout(self, flexible: bool = True)
methods.description: Abstract method to generate output layout, flexible or fixed.

methods.name: tuple[sympy.Integer,sympy.Integer,sympy.Integer] mnk_symbolic( self, )
methods.description: Returns symbolic M, N, K dimensions for matmul, based on input nodes.

methods.name: out_dtype
methods.description: Returns the output dtype; if not set, infers from mat1 and mat2.

methods.name: output_layout
methods.description: Creates and returns layout object for the output tensor, flexible or fixed.

methods.name: tuple[Any,Any] mat1mat2(self)
methods.description: Returns the two matrix input nodes for matmul.

methods.name: tuple[int,int,int] mnk_hinted(self)
methods.description: Returns hinted integer dimensions for M, N, K.

methods.name: int batch_hinted(self)
methods.description: Returns batch size for batched matmul, defaults to 1 for non-batch.
